protocol.coefficient_minimum: actual per-field minimum; no fitted or calibrated parameter
protocol.confidence_intervals: 5000 by default paired whole-field bootstraps, conditional on frozen predictor and sampled distribution
protocol.cost_relationship: both bounds share one Poisson solve; flux variant adds coefficient-weighted face sums
protocol.flux_bound: sqrt(diag(B^-1) * E_eq / a_min), E_eq=sum(q_face^2/W_A_face), q=W_B D.T B^-1 d
protocol.interpretation: classical equilibrated-flux/Thomson majorant, not a novel theorem
protocol.numeric_scope: exact-arithmetic discrete inequality evaluated in float64, not an outward-rounded certificate
protocol.numeric_tolerance: 1e-10*max(max(abs(error)),1e-12)+1e-13, evaluation only, not applied to bounds or flags
protocol.rank_policy: strict top-ceil(10%*N^2) separation; no true errors enter decisions
